name: Game rule: units fight
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game's rules (from sources): each card attacks the opponent's card in the same column; an unopposed card attacks the opponent directly (Wikipedia).

name: Game rule: Bones from deaths
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game's rules (from sources): whenever a card on the player's side perishes for any reason the player gets 1 Bone (wiki Bones).

name: Game rule: units can be sacrificed
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game's rules (from sources): almost any card can be sacrificed for 1 Blood; sacrificing kills the card (wiki Blood).

name: Game rule: Blood costs
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game's rules (from sources): a Blood card is played by sacrificing cards in play (Wikipedia; wiki Blood).

name: Game rule: Bones costs
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game's rules (from sources): a Bones card takes its cost from the player's total (wiki Bones).

name: Game rule: Green Mox costs
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game's rules (from sources): a Mox card of the right colour must be on the player's side to play a Mox creature (wiki Mox).
